notes.title: Next Fest 2025 day 3 streaming!
notes.content:
[p][b]Day 3: The Graveyard Shift[/b]
The dead are relentless — but so are we. On this final day of our broadcast series, we’re jumping back into [i]Ghouls & Guardians[/i] for more undead-crushing action.[/p][p][i]Haven’t played yet? The demo is still live![/i]
[i]Download it, test your strategy, and help us shape the game by leaving feedback.[/i]
Stick around for dev insights, tips for surviving the harder waves, and a peek at what’s next.[/p][p]Let’s give these ghouls a burial they won’t forget.[/p][p][/p][p]ALSO, we'll be posting our roadmap soon![/p]

notes.title: Next Fest 2025 Day 2 Broadcast
notes.content:
[p][b]Day 2: The Dead Don’t Rest — and Neither Should You[/b]
Join us live as we continue the descent into the grim world of [i]Ghouls & Guardians[/i]. The village is under siege, and your strategic mind is needed.[/p][p][/p][p][i]The demo is live — download it now, build your defenses, and hold the line against the rising dead.[/i]
[/p][p]We’d love to hear what you think — leave feedback, share your thoughts, and help shape the future of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Your fight begins now. Let’s bury some ghouls together.[/p][p][/p][p]And just in case you missed it, the new demo is out.[/p][p][/p][p]🛠 Release Notes:[/p][p]🎮 Gameplay[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]New The Hills level with terrain variations that offer a fresh gameplay experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Smart tower combinations and damage upgrades are now key to mastering each wave.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother animations and improved ragdolls for all enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Wave difficulty has been adjusted for better pacing and challenge.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]🎨 Visuals[/p][list][*][p]All tower visuals have been revamped![/p][/*][*][p]Health bars now scale with enemy size and feature responsive hit feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]New VFX for projectiles hitting terrain and enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved camera angle, FOV, and dynamic auto-zoom.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced lighting, post-processing, resource meshes, and fog across maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Skills UI now displays the target tower with a dedicated icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual upgrades to The Bridge level.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy sizes rebalanced to better fit the environment.[/p][/*][*][p]New clothing visuals for sawmill and mining camp workers.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🔊 Audio[/p][list][*][p]New music to enhance ambiance and atmosphere throughout each run.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved SFX for combat and environmental interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]🐛 Bug Fixes & Optimization[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several bugs to improve stability and performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized enemy-targeting routines for better tower efficiency.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Gameplay!
notes.content: [p][b]Join us for a spine-chilling deep dive into Ghouls & Guardians![/b][/p][p]Watch live gameplay, maybe developer commentary, and behind-the-scenes insights as we reveal the twisted world of this dark medieval tower defense game. Learn how to build your defenses, harness cursed powers, and face off against relentless ghoul hordes. Ask questions, share feedback, and get a first look at what’s coming next.[/p][p]Your village’s survival depends on it. Are you ready to lead the last line of defense?[/p]
